title: Effect of a self-assembled 3D flower-like hierarchical architecture on the thermoelectric properties of Ag-doped Bi2S3
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38035-38043
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04467C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
T. Manimozhi, S. Kavirajan, M. Navaneethan, A. Joseph Sagaya Kennedy
Ag doping in Bi2S3 improved thermoelectric properties by lowering the bandgap, enhancing conductivity, and reducing thermal conductivity to 0.415 W mK−1 via phonon scattering. At 543 K, 0.025% Ag-doped Bi2S3 achieved a power factor of 50.1 μW mK−2.
